summary: Advanced Flower Capital Inc. filed an 8-K on June 26, 2026, regarding Amendment Number Nine to its existing Loan and Security Agreement. The amendment conforms reporting standards for business development companies, sets conditions for including specific credit facilities in the borrower base, and increases aggregate revolver commitments to $110 million with a $30 million temporary increase that will revert to $80 million post-expiration. This is a routine credit facility amendment and does not constitute a special situation; it is a material definitive agreement and direct financial obligation entry with no change of control or strategic transformation.
